title: SREV-112 comserver slave IPC open lifetime

official_ipc_shape.description: Official Win32 named synchronization and file mapping shape

official_com_shape.description: Official COM thread initialization and process security shape

source_change.description: RunSlave startup validation, Event2 check, and cleanup hardening

runtime_matrix.description: Windows COM proxy startup/open failure/runtime proof

contracts: RunSlave accepts only the bounded parent-generated proxy command line
the proxy command line must contain the colon separator before object-name suffix replacement
the slave opens the parent-created mutex request event reply event and file mapping by name in the Global namespace
Event1 is the request event waited by the slave
Event2 is the reply event signaled by the slave after writing pMap
each opened kernel handle is owned by the slave process and is closed on startup failure
each mapped view returned by MapViewOfFile is owned by the slave process and is unmapped on startup failure
CoInitializeEx must succeed before COM library calls are used by the slave
successful CoInitializeEx is balanced by CoUninitialize on the local cleanup path
this SREV must not change object names access masks COM request dispatch or parent death ExitProcess behavior
